name: NCAA D-III North Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Northfield, MN · host St. Olaf · Tostrud Center
headline: NCAA D-III North Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Men: No. 5 UW-La Crosse and No. 7 UW-Stevens Point. Women: No. 4 UW-La Crosse, No. 18 Carleton, No. 26 UW-Stevens Point and No. 27 UW-Eau Claire, on the course that hosts nationals a week later. Nationals bids are on the line for the NCAA D-III Championships on Nov. 21 in Northfield, Minn. · Women 6K 11:00 a.m. CT · Men 8K 12:00 p.m. CT
